tasks.name: Fleet Coordinated Takeoff and Formation (3 Drones) 1
tasks.content: Three-drone coordination exercise: Drone 4, Drone 2, and Drone 7 take off together to 16 meters altitude, then hold formation at positions (431, 552, 16), (724, 404, 16), and (510, 684, 16) respectively for synchronized operation. Then all three drones move north for 75m, and next move east for 82m. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (north 75m, then east 82m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.

All drones must complete the full directional distance (north 75m, east 82m) from their respective positions, adjusting as needed to avoid obstacles.

Three-drone formation drill: launch Drone 4, Drone 2, and Drone 7 to altitude 16m, hold stations at (431, 552, 16), (724, 404, 16), and (510, 684, 16) respectively, then shift north by 75 meters and east by 82 meters in synchronized operation. Each drone travels the specified distance in each direction regardless of obstacles encountered.

Execute synchronized operation with Drone 4, Drone 2, Drone 7: take off reaching 16 meters height, maintain formation at coordinates (431, 552, 16), (724, 404, 16), and (510, 684, 16) respectively, then proceed north for 75m and subsequently east for 82m together, with each drone completing the full directed movements by repositioning around obstacles if necessary.
